title: Anonymous Blog
summary: A blog where anyone can write without revealing who they are.
body: A blog where people write anything meaningful, or just for fun, without revealing their identity.

highlights.title: Two ways to sign in
highlights.text: Local accounts or Google sign-in, both through Passport.

highlights.title: Posts with images
highlights.text: Writers can attach an image to a post.
